added.title: Sr. Digital Product Manager
added.description:
1166791_RR00124139 Job ID: 1166791_RR00124139

NYU Langone Health is a fully integrated health system that consistently achieves the best patient outcomes through a rigorous focus on quality that has resulted in some of the lowest mortality rates in the nation. Vizient Inc. has ranked NYU Langone the No. 1 comprehensive academic medical center in the country for three years in a row, and U.S. News & World Report recently placed nine of its clinical specialties among the top five in the nation. NYU Langone offers a comprehensive range of medical services with one high standard of care across 6 inpatient locations, its Perlmutter Cancer Center, and over 320 outpatient locations in the New York area and Florida. With $14.2 billion in revenue this year, the system also includes two tuition-free medical schools, in Manhattan and on Long Island, and a vast research enterprise with over $1 billion in active awards from the National Institutes of Health.

For more information, go to NYU Langone Health , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X , YouTube and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Sr. Digital Product Manager.

This is an opportunity with NYU Langone Healths cutting-edge digital team as a Digital Product Manager. You will be a part of a large healthcare organization, but in a department whose culture is similar to that in tech. You will be responsible for improving the digital experience, through the conception, development, launch, and iterative improvement of products providing the underlying data services that drive our world class patient digital experience . This includes but is not limited to our provider data hub, provider location architecture, and integration services supporting the public web and online scheduling. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to digital product innovation across our clinical, research and education missions.

NYU Langone has heavily invested in digital capabilities and innovation across patient, workforce, research, and clinical experience areas. To design, engineer, and deliver innovative products in the digital health landscape, we are looking for a Digital Product Manager. Product Managers at NYU Langone are expected to have a digital product development background, UX sensibility, and the ability to meaningfully contribute to the design and delivery of custom, SAAS, and enterprise solutions. You will report to the Director of Digital Products.

Job Responsibilities

Leads day to day planning, prioritization, execution, operational maintenance for full product/experience (multiple streams of work)
Leads 1 or more product delivery pods (currently, Provider Data Management, Web Services, and Faculty Scheduling) to execute against product roadmaps (e.g. engineers/QA)
Builds organizational knowledge and develops relationships with business and operational partners
Maintains product roadmap and strategy documentation and navigates prioritization and product decision making with stakeholders and development teams
Conducts technology or product assessments for competitive analysis Establishes and measures product success criteria and metrics
Develops solutions to problems by collaborating as needed with cross-functional partners across the organization (Operations, Marketing, Communications, Clinical, Analytics, Security, UX/Design) and across IT product areas
May supervisor others, including contractors

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
6+ years of experience working as part of a digital product team.
Adept at translating product strategies into delivery roadmaps.
Experience leading an agile product development team to deliver products aligned to business strategy and user needs.
Experience facilitating the digital product development lifecycle (e.g., product vision, feature prioritization, documenting and driving requirements, and product testing, launch, analytics, and maintenance).
Experience with stakeholder management.
Ability to navigate across distributed teams and apply sound judgement through ambiguity.
Demonstrated practical application of advanced analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
Experience soliciting, interpreting and applying user and stakeholder feedback to shape products and features. Mastery of product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Clickup, etc.) to lead delivery teams, manage documentation, and track progress against the roadmap.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing and managing stakeholder and vendor relationships.
Creative self-starter with demonstrated ability to innovate and deliver value in novel ways.
Knowledgeable about user experience.
Displays emotional intelligence.
Able to function well in an autonomous environment.
Passion for healthcare.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Langone Health provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents.

At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Langone Health is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

added.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic Operations
added.description:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy ,
creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

The Role

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to build CCC’s Agentic Operations for Auto Insurance Claims product line from the ground up. This is a new product line focused on AI agents that can carry claims work end to end and take action within the workflows carriers already use to run their business.

This role is ideal for a product leader who is energized by zero-to-one product building, complex enterprise workflows, regulated environments, and the opportunity to define how agentic AI can safely and effectively operate in high-stakes claims processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the strategy, roadmap, and commercial case for a new agentic product line, from first concept through market validation
Decide what the agents actually do: which claims workflows they take end to end, where a human stays in the loop, and how much autonomy they earn as evidence comes in
Set the quality and safety bar (evals, guardrails, escalation paths, audit trails) and work out what a carrier needs to see before it will let an agent touch a live claim
Work with senior claims executives at major carriers to find the problems worth solving and test product ideas against them. CCC's relationships get you the meeting; what happens next is on you
Sell it yourself. Build the pitch, the pricing story, and the proof points with sales, customer success, and product marketing, and be in the room when it lands or doesn't
Write code and build working agents alongside your engineers, using AI coding tools as a core part of how you work
Set value propositions, adoption hypotheses, and kill criteria for every bet, and have the discipline to walk away from work that isn't landing

Requirements:

6+ years of product management experience in enterprise software or high-production SaaS environment
At least one 0-to-1 product build, ideally in a startup or high-velocity environment
Deep experience in at least one complex, regulated vertical
Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI-driven products; experience with LLM-based or agentic systems strongly preferred
Track record of working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders to validate product direction
Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward action and learning over extensive upfront planning
Experience delivering results in a sales/GTM context, personally carrying a product into the market and communicating well with everyone from end users to C-level executives

Interview Policy & Privacy Notice:

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.

About CCC's Commitment to Employees:

CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including:

401K Match
Paid time off
Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus
Comprehensive health insurance
Adoption Assistance
Tuition Reimbursement
Wellness Programs
Stock Purchase Plan options
Employee Resource Groups

For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site.

Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here

added.title: Executive Director, Product Communications & Engagement  MariTide
added.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you are a part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do. Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What You Will Do

At Amgen, our mission is to serve patients by transforming the promise of science into life-changing medicines. Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide, translating the Obesity & Related Conditions Corporate Affairs vision into integrated communications that support launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion. Reporting to the Associate Vice President, Corporate Affairs, you will serve as the Corporate Affairs lead for MariTide, ensuring product communications, content, digital, and executive communications work together as one cohesive strategy. You will partner closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Enterprise Communications, and other cross-functional leaders to align Corporate Affairs priorities with business objectives while preserving the function's trusted role in scientific communications, disease education, stakeholder engagement, and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Product Communications Leadership

Lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide across launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion
Develop differentiated product narratives grounded in science, patient insights and unmet need that reinforce MariTide's value and long-term impact
Translate the broader Corporate Affairs strategy into integrated communications plans that engage patients, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and other stakeholders
Provide strategic counsel to senior leaders on product communications opportunities, risks, and reputation

Communications Governance & Cross-Functional Integration

Lead integrated communications planning for MariTide, establishing priorities and ensuring alignment across Corporate Affairs and cross-functional partners.
Represent Corporate Affairs within cross-functional launch planning and governance forums
Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Advocacy, Market Access, and Enterprise Communications to ensure coordinated execution around key product milestones
Identify opportunities to amplify scientific, regulatory, and commercial milestones through strategic Corporate Affairs communications

Content, Digital & Engagement Leadership

Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the Product Communications, Content and Digital Communications organization
Lead the teams responsible for editorial strategy, executive thought leadership, internal product communications, owned channels, patient storytelling, scientific storytelling, and digital engagement
Drive an integrated content ecosystem across earned, owned and digital channels while leveraging analytics, audience insights, and emerging technologies to optimize impact
Coach and develop direct reports while fostering a collaborative, high-performing and innovative team culture

Strategic Partnership with Media Relations

Partner closely with the Senior Director, Global Media Relations to ensure product communications strategy informs earned media engagement, executive visibility, thought leadership and issues preparedness
Ensure seamless coordination between product communications and media relations to deliver a consistent external narrative for MariTide across all stakeholder audiences

Leadership

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and influence decisions across a complex global matrix organization
Lead agency partners and communications investments with clear accountability for measurable business outcomes
Build strong partnerships across the Obesity Corporate Affairs leadership team to deliver an integrated communications approach

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree & 6 years of product communications experience OR
Masters degree & 10 years of product communications experience OR
Bachelors degree & 12 years of product communications experience AND
6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications

Executive-level experience leading Corporate Affairs or Product Communications for a late-stage or commercial biopharmaceutical product
Experience supporting major product launches, commercialization, and lifecycle communications
Experience leading integrated product communications in partnership with Commercial, Medical, and other cross-functional functions
Experience leading and developing high-performing communications teams.
Experience overseeing content strategy, digital communications, executive thought leadership, and internal product communications
Experience partnering with media relations leaders to deliver coordinated product communications strategies
Ability to translate complex science into compelling communications for diverse stakeholder audiences
Ability to influence senior executives and lead through a highly matrixed global organization
Executive presence, organizational leadership, and business acumen consistent with an Executive Director role at Amgen
Experience using communications analytics, audience insights, and AI-enabled communications tools to optimize strategy and impact

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What You Can Expect Of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. added.title: Product Director - Controls Room - Executive Director (604)
added.description:
Job Description

The Controls Room team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage the control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence across lines of business and corporate functions.

As a Product Owner – Executive Director in the Controls Room, you will own the product strategy and delivery of the STEP application, used by First Line of Defense (1LOD) Control Testers and enabling Second Line of Defense (2LOD) Compliance oversight. You will be accountable for delivering measurable improvements in how test plans are designed, monitored, and executed - leveraging AI and agentic workflows to increase efficiency, consistency, and transparency while maintaining appropriate controls and human oversight.

Job Responsibilities

Define and drive product strategy for STEP and associated Controls Room capabilities, aligning product vision to 1LOD testing needs and 2LOD Compliance oversight objectives.
Lead customer discovery (research, workflow analysis, pain-point identification) to translate user needs into a prioritized roadmap and clear value proposition.
Lead AI enablement within the product, identifying high-impact use cases (e.g., NLP-driven insights, automation, decision support), shaping an AI integration strategy, and guiding responsible deployment with appropriate controls and monitoring.
Deliver iteratively using agile practices and small, empowered teams (e.g., Pizza POD), accelerating time-to-value through rapid prototyping, and continuous feedback loops.
Coaches and mentors the STEP Product team on best practices, such as solution generation, market research, prototyping methods, product adoption strategies, and product delivery, enabling them to effectively deliver on objectives.
Partners across line of defense to identify, validate, and scale reusable testing solutions and components, driving efficiency and scale.
Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria are well-defined, testable, and aligned to outcomes (and evolving approach as the firm evolves the software development lifecycle).
Establish and track success metrics (e.g., tester productivity, cycle time, coverage, control outcomes, reliability, risk posture, and cost) and use data to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
Act as the voice of the customer, partnering with stakeholders to evolve operational policies, process flows, procedures, tooling, and user communications where required to enable adoption.
Evaluate “build vs. partner vs. defer” decisions for emerging AI/ agentic capabilities and balancing speed, scalability, and risk.
Support go-to-market and change management including launch planning, training/ readiness, documentation, and post-launch support to drive adoption and measurable business impact.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Demonstrated experience owning and delivering a product(s) across the full product lifecycle (discovery, delivery, adoption, optimization), with accountability for outcomes and performance.
Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled capabilities in production (e.g., NLP, intelligent automation, decision support), including model/ product iteration, monitoring, and stakeholder readiness.
Experience incorporating agentic patterns/ workflows into products (e.g., orchestration, tool-use, human-in-the-loop review) with an emphasis on control, transparency, and auditability.
Proven ability to deliver in an iterative, fast-paced model using short development cycles and small teams (e.g., Pizza POD), partnering tightly with design and engineering.
Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, UI/UX Design, Data, Control Testing Center of Excellence (TCOE), Compliance, and senior leadership-aligning outcomes, negotiating trade-offs, and driving timely decisions.
Proven track record leading large, complex initiatives impacting multiple stakeholders, with strong written/oral communication at a senior executive level.
Understanding of risk and controls concepts, in risk management, assessment, control evaluations or testing,
10 years of experience delivering products, projects, or technology applications at scale.
Strong knowledge of the product development lifecycle, technical design concepts, and data/ analytics fundamentals; ability to translate complex needs into clear requirements.
Experience driving organizational change and enabling adoption through communications, training, and operating model/process updates.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience working in or closely with audit, compliance, risk management; strong understanding of internal controls.
Experience with modern data and analytics tools (e.g., Databricks, ThoughtSpot, Genie, Sigma, Prophecy, Python).

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

You will lead with impact, collaborating across teams to deliver innovative solutions that unify client data and drive business growth. Here, your expertise will help us deliver operational excellence and empower enterprise-wide transformation. Be part of a team where your leadership and vision make a difference.

As a Product Director in Data, Digital and AI, you lead innovation through the development of products and features that delight customers. As a leader on the team, you leverage your advanced capabilities to challenge traditional approaches, remove barriers to success, and foster a culture of continuous innovation that helps inspire cross-functional teams create groundbreaking solutions that address customer needs.

added.title: Principal Clinical Product Manager
added.description:
We are conducting a confidential search for a Principal Clinical Product Manager
to join an innovative healthcare AI company developing advanced predictive technology designed to help care teams identify and intervene with patients before chronic disease progresses.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of clinical medicine, healthcare data, product management, and AI/data science
.

This is not a traditional healthcare SaaS product management role
. We are looking for someone who has worked directly with patient-level clinical data and understands how to turn complex EHR and claims data into meaningful, safe, and actionable tools for clinicians and care teams.

What You’ll Do:

You will serve as the clinical product lead for an AI-powered disease trajectory platform, helping shape how predictive insights are translated into real-world clinical workflows.
You’ll work closely with clinicians, data scientists, engineers, and healthcare leaders to:
Own clinical product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and releases
Translate clinical needs into product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data definitions
Build and validate patient cohorts and computable phenotypes using diagnosis, procedure, medication, laboratory, encounter, and utilization data
Partner with data science teams to define model populations, outcomes, labels, validation requirements, reliability thresholds, and release criteria
Design patient lists, registries, dashboards, work queues, alerts, and clinical summaries that clinicians can actually use
Evaluate data quality and determine how products should respond to incomplete, delayed, conflicting, or inconsistent clinical information
Conduct discovery directly with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, care managers, and population-health teams
Help ensure AI-generated predictions and recommendations are clinically explainable, actionable, and safe
Support clinical data integration and exchange using HL7/FHIR and healthcare terminology standards

What We’re Looking For:

The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of experience
in healthcare analytics, clinical informatics, population health, healthcare technology product management, or a related field, along with substantial hands-on experience working with patient-level clinical data.
Strong candidates will have experience with:
EHR and claims data
ICD-10-CM and healthcare coding/terminology such as CPT/HCPCS, NDC/RxNorm, LOINC, and SNOMED CT
Building and validating clinical cohorts or computable phenotypes
AI, machine learning, or predictive analytics products in healthcare
Clinical workflow discovery and product design
Working directly with data science and engineering teams
Data quality, clinical safety, and explainability
Agile product development and backlog prioritization
HL7 and/or FHIR clinical data exchange

Experience with chronic disease populations such as diabetes, CKD, COPD, or cardiovascular disease
is highly desirable.

Experience with population health, value-based care, payer analytics, ACOs, case management, CMS quality programs, HEDIS, Stars, risk adjustment, Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, or government healthcare environments
is also a plus.

We’re particularly interested in candidates who can move comfortably between a conversation with a physician, an analysis of clinical data, and a working session with data scientists and engineers.

Why This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how AI is used to identify disease progression and support earlier clinical intervention. You’ll work alongside experienced healthcare, clinical, and data science leaders and help shape technology designed to improve healthcare outcomes at scale.
